The '''Qarohan Steppes''' were a region on the tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] located in the [[Jasserak Highlands]]<ref name="MedStar II" /> around eighty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] southeast of the previous location of the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] near the [[Kondrus Sea]] in the [[Jasserak Lowlands]].<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
